name: Valencia
scopeLimits: The UN WUP 2025 point is a settlement-population locator, not an official city boundary, property identity, or completeness statement. No owner, address, applicant, or tax data was requested or retained; no account credentials, CAPTCHA, or token was used. City tax/cadastre ordinances and the contributor portal are evidence of municipal cadastre, not anonymous parcel vectors.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Municipio Valencia SIGAT tax-administration portal identifies Valencia in Carabobo. The municipal urban-property ordinance assigns upkeep of the fiscal urban cadastre to the Alcaldía through its Dirección de Catastro. No public anonymous parcel-map feature service was identified.
